name: runner-late-observation-tests
goal: Two added regressions on the frozen runner: an observation released after runIsolated answered signals nothing, and a late or cancelled probe ends its own tool. No product change.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Review asked for two more cases: no delayed TERM or KILL when a held observation answers after runIsolated has, and a late or cancelled probe ends its own tool, shown by that tool's id and start time.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/late-cleanup.test.ts (34e5287ccc751de4), unchanged, against the kept pre-repair sources: 4 failed. Runner never answered and both stand-ins were dead after release; the stuck tool still ran. /tmp/harness-late-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Test only: test/late-cleanup.test.ts, generated with harness generate test. No product source, manifest or earlier test changed; every hash in /tmp/harness-repair-hashes.txt still matches.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same file against the frozen product: 4 passed; with the nine earlier files 50 passed (/tmp/harness-late-green.log). One earlier test is intermittent on its own: see /tmp/harness-late-combined-intermittent.log.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
